recruiterCard.summary: Built backend APIs and an asynchronous LLM extraction pipeline for an AWS-hosted clinical-trial data platform.
impactBullets: Built NestJS/TypeScript REST APIs and versioned PostgreSQL schemas that held p95 latency under 300 ms across 20,000+ staging requests.

Built an asynchronous LLM extraction pipeline that drafts eCRF study builds from protocols, with Redis-backed queues, retries, and output validation, helping cut first-pass study setup from eight hours to 40 minutes.
Measured 91% exact match against 1,200 human-reviewed protocol elements and 94% validity across 300 generated edit checks.
Wrote 250+ automated tests (86% coverage) for the NestJS/PostgreSQL platform.
